$$
\begin{aligned}∇f(x,y) & =\frac{∂}{∂x}({e}^{x+y}+4x+y)\,i+\frac{∂}{∂y}({e}^{x+y}+4x+y)\,j \\  & =({e}^{x+y}+4)\,i+({e}^{x+y}+1)\,j \\ ∇f(-3,3) & =({e}^{-3+(3)}+4)\,i+({e}^{-3+(3)}+1)\,j \\  & =5\,i+2\,j\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∇f(-3,3)}{‖∇f(-3,3)‖} & =\frac{5\,i+2\,j}{\sqrt{(5)^{2}+(2)^{2}}} \\  & =\frac{5\,i+2\,j}{\sqrt{29}} \\  & =\frac{\sqrt{29}}{29}(5\,i+2\,j)\end{aligned}
